title.narrative: EU Support to Decentralization (SO1): Decentralization for Development - D4D.

description.narrative: The Decentralization for Development D4D project is part of the EU programme Support to the consolidation of peace process in Mozambique: Support to Decentralization. The project is expected to contribute to the Government's national program to support decentralization, which will be supported by UNDP through its Decentralized Governance Promotion Program (DGPP). The National Decentralization Plan (PND) is, during the formulation of this proposal, still in progress. The project will focus on different interventions at the national and subnational levels. Throughout this proposal, the subnational level refers primarily to the provincial level, and the scope of the subnational level interventions for this proposal encompasses the provinces of Sofala, Cabo Delgado, and Manica, which together make up the three selected pilot provinces for this project.
